mapper.insert: INSERT INTO account_tbl ( account_id, account_pw, account_name, email, phone_number, account_role, reg_date ) VALUES ( #{accountId}, #{accountPw}, #{accountName}, #{email}, #{phoneNumber}, 'USER', SYSDATE )

INSERT INTO account_tbl ( account_id, account_name, email, social_type, social_id, account_role, reg_date ) VALUES ( #{accountId}, #{accountName}, #{email, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{socialType}, #{socialId}, 'USER', SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM account_tbl WHERE reset_token = #{token} AND reset_token_expire > SYSTIMESTAMP
mapper.update: UPDATE account_tbl SET reset_token = NULL, reset_token_expire = NULL WHERE account_id = #{accountId}

MERGE INTO email_verification evt USING dual ON (evt.email = #{email}) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET evt.code = #{code}, evt.expire_at = #{expireTime}, evt.verified = 'N' WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (email, code, expire_at, verified) VALUES (#{email}, #{code}, #{expireTime}, 'N')
